item.title: Attorney General Ellison wins dismissal of Trump lawsuit to compel Minnesota to enforce failed federal immigration policy
Attorney General Ellison opposes Trump rollback of PFAS limits in drinking water
item.description:
Publication Date: July 21, 2026

PFAS — ‘forever chemicals’ — are toxic to humans and animals in very low concentrations; Trump EPA rule would mean public drinking-water systems will no longer be required to test for PFAS, report how much of them are in drinking water, or treat drinking water to remove them

https://www.ag.state.mn.us/Office/Communications/2026/07/21_Drinking-Water.asp
